svg.title: Existing-system routes
svg.desc: Survey and human triage route fixes through fix planning, single features through BA, Architect and Tech Lead, and multi-feature programs through phase planning. All routes rejoin human eval approval, serial development and conditional final verification.
svg.text: Survey first. Confirm the scope. Reuse the shared delivery workflow.
Approved fix plan → synthesize stories → generate eval manifest
Deep survey first · one change run · no Phase Planner
Deep survey first · BA and Phase Planner each have AI validation + human approval
Reuse program workflow · each phase uses its assigned requirements and application type
ALL ROUTES REJOIN THE SAME DELIVERY CHECKS
Use the main diagram from the human eval gate (05), then continuation A. Existing code is edited in place.
After corpus replay: run DevOps / Packaging only if infrastructure changes are required; otherwise skip to completion.
Bug fix / small change: criterion edits reopen Fix Planner. New features: reopen Technical Lead, Architect or BA as applicable.
Eval approval freezes the specification. Existing failures are reported; new failures versus the baseline block progress.
Flat change run: one PR. Phased program: merge each phase before starting the next; only remaining phases may be replanned.
Source: start-run Steps B1–B5 / BP1–BP5, brownfield-driver, advance-stage and shared stage handlers.
